objective: Restore WEBKAS on the new free Supabase project without losing member identities, wallet balances, dues, payment history, proof files, permissions, or scheduled behavior.
execution_mode: staged; read-only until verified backup and restore path are proven

phases.name: Secure execution and preflight
actions: Obtain an authenticated execution environment with Supabase CLI, PostgreSQL client tools, and secure access to both projects.
Confirm source and target project refs, region, Free plan status, and current health.
Check available disk space and network egress; keep credentials in the environment secret store only.
phases.gate: No production writes; source and target identity verified.

phases.name: Immutable source backups
actions: Create schema-only and data backups with PostgreSQL tooling using a documented, version-compatible procedure.
Capture migration history, extensions, grants, policies, triggers, indexes, functions, publication membership, and cron definitions.
Determine and validate a supported Auth migration procedure that preserves user UUIDs and password hashes; do not assume an ordinary Auth user-list export preserves passwords.
Download all objects from payment-proofs, profile-photos, and registration-proofs; record object paths, sizes, and checksums.
Capture all seven Edge Function source files and record their deployed versions and hashes.
Record source row counts and accounting control totals.
phases.gate: Every backup artifact exists, is readable, has checksums, and is stored outside the source project.

phases.name: Restore into target without cutover
actions: Restore schema and required extensions in dependency order, resolving migration drift without replaying the incomplete repository migration folder blindly.
Restore data while preserving UUIDs and foreign-key relationships.
Restore and validate Auth identities using the approved method.
Create private Storage buckets and restore objects with matching paths and metadata.
Restore RLS, grants, triggers, functions, Realtime publication, and cron jobs; keep cash-changing scheduled jobs disabled until validation is complete.
Deploy Edge Functions with target URL, anon key, and service-role secret provisioned only through a secure secret channel.
phases.gate: Target structure, identities, object counts, function versions, policies, and scheduler configuration match the signed-off source snapshot.

phases.name: Data integrity and application tests
actions: Compare row counts and deterministic checksums for financial and membership tables.
Compare each member wallet balance and arrears total; verify aggregate totals match source snapshot.
Test dues start-date catch-up, no duplicate daily dues, arrears-first payments, rank-rate effective dates, and pending-payment uniqueness on isolated test fixtures.
Test login with preserved identity, role-specific access, registration, payment approval/rejection, Storage reads, and Edge Function CORS.
Run frontend build and mobile smoke tests against target only.
phases.gate: All critical tests pass and financial control totals match exactly.

phases.name: Controlled cutover and rollback
actions: Take a final source delta backup during a planned maintenance window.
Apply and verify the final delta on target; prevent concurrent writes during the final synchronization window.
Update frontend environment to target and deploy only after explicit release approval.
Verify live login, wallet display, payment workflow, dues, chat, and Storage from production.
Keep source project intact as rollback source; document exact frontend rollback procedure.
phases.gate: Production operates on target, key flows verified, and rollback remains possible.

non_negotiable_controls: Do not paste credentials, service-role keys, database passwords, or OTPs into chat.
Do not delete, pause, reset, or modify the source project during preparation.
Do not point the frontend at the empty target.
Do not replay all repository migrations blindly: source has 104 applied migrations but only 68 migration files in the repo.
Do not alter the P4 effective rate discrepancy (600 vs expected 500 UIC) during migration; reconcile separately with a financial backfill plan.
Do not alter treasury-history Admin Assistant permissions until the current rule is confirmed.
Do not enable cash-changing cron jobs on target before data integrity checks pass.
Do not claim success until the final live smoke tests and accounting comparisons pass.
